items.item_text: 01. Temporary positions with SCCCD DO NOT turn into permanent positions. Do you understand this working condition? Options: Yes | No
02. Are you available for a temporary assignment at this time? Options: Yes | No

03. Experience Requirement: One year of full-time experience is equivalent to 12 months of employment at 40 hours per week. Qualifying part-time experience will be prorated based on its full-time equivalent. Experience must be directly related to the position. Education Requirement: Thirty (30) semester units or forty-five (45) quarter units in a directly related field are equivalent to one (1) year of experience or one (1) year of school. All education and experience used to meet minimum qualifications must be clearly documented in the application. Do you understand this condition? Options: Yes | No

04. (MQ) Please select the level of education you possess in kinesiology, health sciences or a related field: Please attach a copy of transcripts showing when degree was awarded or your application may be deemed incomplete. Options: Formal or informal education equivalent to completion of the twelfth grade OR no related degree | Associate's degree | Bachelor's degree | Master's degree or higher

05. (MQ) Please select the years of responsible professional experience you possess performing preventative and rehabilitative athletic modalities in competitive sports programs: Options: Less than two (2) year of experience | Two (2) to less than three (3) years of experience | Three (3) to less than five (5) years of experience | Five (5) to less than seven (7) years of experience | Seven (7) or more years of experience

06. (MQ) Do you possess a valid Certification by the National Athletic Trainers Association Board of Certification? Please attach copies of licenses and/or certifications or your application may be deemed incomplete. Options: Yes | No
07. (MQ) Do you possess Certification in Basic Life Support? Please attach copies of licenses and/or certifications or your application may be deemed incomplete. Options: Yes | No
08. (MQ) Do you possess a valid driver's license? Options: Yes | No
